svg.text: Question — architecture
Electron desktop app. Plain files are the source of truth; everything else is disposable or in-memory.
Renderer process — sandboxed
contextIsolation: true · nodeIntegration: false · sandbox: true
renderer/index.html
Single-file HTML/CSS/JS UI, no framework, no build step. Holds all state in memory
(requests, questions, views/requestsControls, current answer, recent-asks feed) and re-renders on every change.
Has no filesystem or Node access of
its own — only window.questionAPI.
window.questionAPI.loadAll() / .syncAll(payload)
contextBridge — preload.cjs
exposeInMainWorld("questionAPI", { loadAll, syncAll })
The only two calls that ever cross from renderer to main — everything else stays out of the page's reach.
ipcRenderer.invoke("question:loadAll" / "question:syncAll")
Main process — main.cjs
• Creates the BrowserWindow and enforces the Content-Security-Policy header
• ipcMain.handle("question:loadAll" / "question:syncAll")
• Resolves DATA_DIR — Documents/Question Data, or the QUESTION_DATA_DIR env override
• Resolves SEEDED_MARKER — inside Electron's own per-user app-support directory
Full Node.js access lives only here — never in the renderer.
backend.loadAll(dataDir, markerFile) / backend.syncAll(dataDir, ...)
backend.cjs — plain Node, no Electron APIs
• Reads/writes each request and question as a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter
• Rebuilds the SQLite index from those files on every save (never hand-edited, never assumed to exist)
• Reads/writes settings.json (views, requestsControls, score weights, theme)
• Checks / writes the seeded-marker file (hasEverLaunched / markLaunched)
Zero dependencies — a hand-rolled frontmatter reader/writer and Node's built-in node:sqlite.
reads / writes
checks / writes once
Documents/Question Data/
visible — the real source of truth
feature-requests/*.md
questions/*.md
settings.json
index.sqlite
— disposable: rebuilt from the .md files on every save;
deleting it loses nothing.
Human-readable, yours to back up, sync, or edit directly.
Deleting this whole folder is the app's only reset — see docs/DESIGN.md.
App-support (Electron userData)
hidden — the one deliberate exception
seeded.marker
Holds no user content — one bit only: "has this app ever
produced its example data before, on this machine?"
Lives outside Question Data on purpose, so it survives that
folder being deleted — a reset lands on a genuinely blank
app, and the example data seeds exactly once, ever.
Full rationale for these choices: docs/DESIGN.md
